mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_requests ( request_id, member_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, request_reason, status, request_date, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{memberId}, #{leaveType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{requestReason}, #{status}, #{requestDate}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE leave_requests SET leave_type = #{leaveType}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, request_reason = #{requestReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.select: SELECT lr.*, m.name as member_name FROM leave_requests lr INNER JOIN members m ON lr.member_id = m.member_id WHERE lr.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY lr.request_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_approvals ( approval_id, request_id, approver_id, approval_status, approval_reason, approval_date, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{approvalId}, #{requestId}, #{approverId}, #{approvalStatus}, #{approvalReason}, #{approvalDate}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT la.*, m.name as approver_name FROM leave_approvals la INNER JOIN members m ON la.approver_id = m.member_id WHERE la.request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT lr.*, m.name as member_name FROM leave_requests lr INNER JOIN members m ON lr.member_id = m.member_id WHERE lr.start_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY lr.start_date ASC
